name: release-readiness-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes accumulated release-validation evidence through judge-release-readiness and emits the CHOSEN verdict as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures how accurately it ships well-evidenced releases and holds releases with unresolved failures or evidence gaps. Pair with datasets/release-readiness-calibration.json + evals/release-readiness-calibration.json.
